name: Backend
description: Server-side logic, services, and domain code not covered by a narrower label.

name: Database
description: Schema, migrations, queries, and data persistence.

name: Bug
description: Defect or incorrect behavior to fix.

name: CI / CD
description: Build pipelines, deployment automation, and release tooling.

name: Cybersecurity
description: Security hardening, vulnerabilities, authz, and threat mitigation.

name: Documentation
description: User docs, API docs, runbooks, and in-repo guides.

name: Frontend
description: UI components, client state, and browser-side behavior.

name: Web
description: Web-specific delivery: routing, SSR, PWA, and browser compatibility.

name: Infra / DevOps
description: Cloud resources, containers, IaC, and operational infrastructure.

name: External Integration
description: Third-party APIs, webhooks, and partner system connectors.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: ML, LLM features, embeddings, and AI-assisted workflows.

name: Prototype
description: Exploratory implementation or throwaway spike toward a product direction.

name: QA / Testing
description: Test automation, test plans, and quality assurance work.

name: Refactoring
description: Structural improvement without intended behavior change.

name: Business Rule
description: Domain rules, validations, and policy-driven behavior.

name: UX / UI
description: Interaction design, visual polish, and usability improvements.

name: Architecture
description: System design, boundaries, patterns, and technical direction.

name: Tech Debt
description: Known shortcuts and cleanup deferred from earlier delivery.

name: Performance
description: Latency, throughput, memory, and scalability improvements.

name: Accessibility
description: WCAG, screen readers, keyboard navigation, and inclusive UX.

name: Mobile
description: Native or hybrid mobile apps and responsive mobile behavior.

name: Analytics
description: Metrics, dashboards, event tracking, and product analytics.

name: Blocked
description: Work cannot proceed until an external dependency is resolved.

name: Observability
description: Logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and on-call signals.

name: API
description: REST, GraphQL, gRPC endpoints, contracts, and API versioning.

name: Auth / Identity
description: Authentication, authorization, sessions, OAuth, and RBAC.

name: i18n / L10n
description: Internationalization, localization, and locale-aware behavior.

name: Compliance
description: Regulatory, audit, retention, and privacy requirements (e.g. LGPD/GDPR).

name: Spike
description: Time-boxed research to reduce uncertainty before committing to delivery.

name: Breaking change
description: Backward-incompatible change requiring migration or release notes.

name: Regression
description: Previously working behavior that broke again.

name: Hotfix
description: Urgent production fix outside the normal release cadence.

name: Design system
description: Shared tokens, primitives, and component library standards.

name: POC
description: Proof of concept to validate feasibility or demo value to stakeholders.

name: Data / ETL
description: Data pipelines, warehousing, batch jobs, and ETL/ELT workflows.

name: Notifications
description: Email, push, SMS, in-app alerts, and delivery channels.

name: Migration
description: Schema, data, or application migration with cutover risk.

name: DevEx
description: Developer experience: local setup, tooling, templates, and inner-loop speed.

name: Customer request
description: Work traceable to a specific customer or sales commitment.
